tutorial.title: How It Works
tutorial.subtitle: Tutorial
tutorial.heroDesc: Learn how to use the admin dashboard step by step. Start with the basics or dive into advanced features.
tutorial.gs1Desc: Enter your app code, then log in with your credentials. You'll land on the dashboard.
tutorial.gs2Desc: The dashboard shows key metrics at a glance. Use the navigation sidebar to access different sections.
tutorial.gs3Desc: Visit Settings to configure your theme and language preferences.
tutorial.userManagementDesc: View and manage users in your organization
tutorial.um1Desc: Go to the Users page to see all users. Use filters to narrow down by branch, division, or status.
tutorial.um2Desc: Use the search bar to find users by name, email, or phone number.
tutorial.um3Desc: Click on any user to view their full profile including contact info and department.
tutorial.aiAssistantDesc: Let AI help you manage your dashboard
tutorial.ai1Desc: Click the AI chat button to open the assistant. Type your question naturally.
tutorial.ai2Desc: Ask about users, settings, or general questions about the dashboard.
tutorial.ai3Desc: When the AI wants to make changes, it will ask for your confirmation first.
tutorial.tipsDesc: Get the most out of the system
tutorial.tp1Desc: Press Cmd+K (or Ctrl+K) to open the command palette for quick navigation and actions.
tutorial.tp2Desc: Use the AI assistant for complex queries — searching users, getting information, and more.
tutorial.tp3Desc: Customize your experience in Settings. Switch between light/dark mode and English/Malay.
